name: indxr-video
description: Standalone Remotion workspace for INDXR marketing clips — deliberately OUTSIDE the Turborepo build graph (ADR-089). Own node_modules, own install, never deploys.

scripts.copy-source: mkdir -p public && cp ../../tests/playwright/capture/recordings/core-flow.webm public/core-flow.webm && cp ../../tests/playwright/capture/recordings/core-flow-dark.webm public/core-flow-dark.webm && for n in input-empty progress-downloading error-no_captions cost-card-ai success-card library-unread transcript-speakers speaker-dialog timestamps-on export-page; do cp ../../apps/marketing/public/docs/screenshots/$n-light.png ../../apps/marketing/public/docs/screenshots/$n-dark.png public/; done
